race.description: Coorparoo Park Stan Sadleir Stakes Hcp
race.comment: HELL OF A FOX (5) looks ready to win third-up after a much better fifth in a BM74 at this track, beaten two and a half lengths while carrying 62.5kg. The weight relief, proven record at this venue and three wins at around 1400m give her the strongest all-round case. SISTER SHAY (4) is the main threat after being held up at Seymour first-up and still finishing within two lengths in a FM BM70. Her 1400m record is a major asset. PAPARAZZO (9) has to rebound from an Albury sixth, but his BM66 win at Cootamundra two back and the sharp weight drop keep him right in play. MATHRIN (7) is third-up, well treated at the weights and has the track-and-trip record to turn recent midfield finishes into a minor-money result.
